input.name: strip_ycbcr
input.strip: profile_scanner.strip_geometry + sample (4.5-20 m, 128 metric columns over +-1.0 m), uint8, rows INTER_AREA (INTER_LINEAR if <128) resized to 128, far rows first; RIGHT strip flipped left/right (mirror_right)

mapping: logits; type argmax unknown -> no inference this frame (paused like lane_prob_dip); P(dashed) = (dashed + dbl_near)/(1 - unknown) (dbl_near = ego-side line of a double marking -> dashed, dbl_far -> solid); P(yellow) = colour softmax yellow, blue shown white; yellow + dashed passed through (strip_model.StripModel.decide4). This is the only StripNet model; it gives both heads.

training.init: type/backbone from the previous lane_strip_v4 (sha256 0e22e71364b6); colour branch from v3
training.data: single/data-rain1024b: data-today1023b + label_fixes.json + 10-24 rain drive 41c (auto labels, 575 user-reviewed rows, Road Viewer bookmarks; dark auto-yellow rows dropped; double rows only where a person confirmed them, 783 -> 659) = 42,066 rows; 417 held out
training.aug: plus-rain-more-nored + synth-double 0.05 (was 0.15) + text negatives (negsyn) 0.25; colour head trained white/yellow, blue logit padded -10000
